newsitem.title: UK: British police battle petrol bomb throwing youths.
newsitem.headline: British police battle petrol bomb throwing youths.

text.p: A gang of about 50 youths threw petrol bombs and bricks in running battles with police in the northern English city of Leeds overnight, the Press Association news agency reported on Saturday.
The agency quoted police as saying there were no casualties but it said up to 20 vehicles, including police patrol cars, were believed to have been damaged in the violence.
Riot police restored order and were maintaining a high-profile presence in the city centre early on Saturday.
The agency said police believed the violence may have been related to an anti-drug operation mounted in the area on Thursday night.
